steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... Guh...!
Muffled noises echo through the empty cavern. Somewhere nearby, excavators continue their endless digging.
The air is colder and colder.
The moment she's out of the cavern, a chill sets in.
But it merely spurs on her heart to run faster.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: How... How do I face her?
She cannot word it. She cannot face it.
Tut tut tut. Whatever will you do?
Sakiko does not need to turn her head to know who it is.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Now this girl's dreamland, I'm rather satisfied with!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Sweet dreams for every child are the duty of the Castle of Dreams, and I've granted each one of her wishes.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Honestly, I'm surprised how smoothly this dream runs—no, flawlessly, in fact. Beyond my wildest expectations.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Besides, things have gotten even more interesting now, you know.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...You're deceiving her.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: No, no, no, nothing of the sort. We've had plenty of dealings, she and I. She knows full well what I am.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Oh, seeing these results just fills my heart with joy.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: She knows it's all a dream and she still doesn't want to leave! Isn't that the very proof my dreamspinning is unmatched?

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Chirping in agreement)

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Oh, you coming here...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Now that's interesting.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Well, I'll leave you two to it, then! I trust you'll soon discover just how amusing this dream really is, Sakiko Togawa.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Sakiko. Everyone's waiting for you. Let's go back.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Go back?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Morpheus just vanished in front of you. Aren't you the least bit surprised...?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Everything here, we imagined together.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: 'We'?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: You... aren't a part of us.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: You play guitar so well, Mutsumi-chan!

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Saki...

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: No. Mum... Where did Saki go?

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Saki-chan? Maybe she just went off somewhere...?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: No, no. Saki... Saki would never abandon me.
The cheering crowd suddenly goes deathly quiet. They all stare straight at Mutsumi.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Mutsumi-chan, you seem to have forgotten—

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: This isn't just your dream.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi's Mother'
steps.text: This is 'our' dream.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: 'Us'.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: In this dream, every 'Mutsumi' has the chance to make her wish come true.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: Together with Mutsumi-chan, we've built a sweet dream that's ours and ours alone—where everyone can dream of happiness.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: We exist in Mutsumi-chan's mind. We've seen her life countless times over.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: In the end, we unanimously agreed that this—is the best ending for all the 'Mutsumis'—

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: And you, Sakiko Togawa, are the enemy of this dream.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mutsumi, what are you talking about?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I don't want you to suffer either, but we shouldn't hide away in dreams like this—

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: No, Mutsumi-chan gets to live a happy life here. That's the most important thing.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: I'm not like the others. I want to talk things out with you, Sakiko.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: You can stay here with me, and we'll protect Mutsumi-chan's sweet dream together.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: She's a fragile child. Odds are she still can't decide whether she wants to wake, or to stay here in bliss.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: So long as you choose to stay as well, and help us keep this dream going, it'll naturally become 'reality'.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: You are the sole determiner of 'reality' here. You are reality.

spans.text: You are the sole determiner of 'reality' here. You

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: So. Stay with us, Sakiko.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I refuse.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: You... refuse?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: In reality, Mutsumi's body is lying out in the cold in the Castle of Dreams. Can you accept that as an ending, too?

spans.text: Mutsumi's body is lying out in the cold in the Castle of Dreams. Can you accept that as an ending, too?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: If you truly love her, you would not be doing this to her.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: As long as Mutsumi-chan is happy, as long as we can exist—what does it matter what's reality or not?!

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: I have Mutsumi-chan's every memory! I know your heart's deepest desire!

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: If you'll just stay here, I can even give you a whole, entire Ave{@nbs}Mujica!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Shut up! You're not Mutsumi at all... She would never say that sort of thing.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: I like you, and I like Mutsumi-chan...

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: Why are you forcing me to choose like this?
An unidentified voice hovers above their heads.
The distant mountains seem to shake. The gravel on the ground jostles to a rhythm.
There's no one around to be seen, but Sakiko can almost feel countless gazes boring into her.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: They're right. To Mutsumi-chan, we are her countless shadows.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: So that the shadows may hide forever in the darkness, even the weakest light must be snuffed out.
Step by tiny step, 'Mutsumi' forces Sakiko towards a precipice.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...What are you doing?!

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: Sakiko...
'Mutsumi' reaches out, placing her hand on Sakiko's shoulder.
Sakiko loses her balance. 'Mutsumi's' figure grows smaller and smaller.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: I want Mutsumi-chan to be happy forever, Sakiko. I also don't want the 'Mutsumis' to have to disappear anymore.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: I just have no choice...

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: Mutsumi-chan... doesn't need you.

a.text: 'Please, just stay like this and don't let go of my hands—'
'Please don't ever, ever let me go.'

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: Goodbye forever, Sakiko.
